definitions.gloss: way of swimming, how to swim
definitions.explanation: The method or technique of swimming. A compound of the verb stem {泳|およ}ぎ (swimming) and {方|かた} (way/method).

examples.japanese: {泳|およ}ぎ{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me how to swim.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{泳|およ}ぎ{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}いたい→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I want to learn the correct way to swim.

notes:
FORMATION: Verb stem + {方|かた} = way of doing

This is a productive pattern in Japanese:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧ (way of eating)
- ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧ (way of writing)
- ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧ (way of reading)
- ⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧ (way of making)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧ (way of using)

The pattern Verb stem + {方|かた} is very useful for asking "how to do" something:
- {泳|およ}ぎ{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (I don't know how to swim)
- {泳|およ}ぎ{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っていますか→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (Do you know how to swim?)
